title: Following the Chipotle playbook for the cyclospora crisis
description: August 6, 2026 • Taco Bell and Taylor Farms are taking hits to their reputation due to the cyclosporiasis outbreak across the country. They could learn a thing or two from Chipotle, which went through its own public relations battle during a similar outbreak about a decade ago.

title: How ending TPS is squeezing workers, businesses and (soon) consumers
description: August 5, 2026 • What happens when roughly a million people working legally in the U.S. suddenly lose that right to stay here? We’re starting to find out in places like Miami, Florida, home to one of the largest Haitian communities in the country. There, we talk to people on what the end of Temporary Protected Status (TPS) means for their businesses and the wider economy.

title: Even Moore’s law can't save affordable tech
description: July 29, 2026 • For decades, consumer tech like laptops and gaming systems got better AND cheaper. Memory shortages caused by the AI boom are making those lower prices a thing of the past.

title: You had housing questions. An economist answered them.
description: July 28, 2026 • The U.S. housing market is pretty weird right now. What policies might unlock the housing inventory held by baby boomers? So we called up someone with answers: Redfin’s chief economist, Daryl Fairweather.
